Services (App Store, iCloud, Apple Intelligence) now 38% of gross profit and growing 14%+ YoY. 2.2B device installed base creates durable lock-in. iPhone supercycle thesis depends on Apple Intelligence adoption. China (-11% YoY) is a headwind. Near 52w high at $313.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py AAPL after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: AWS is the #1 AI infrastructure platform with 35% cloud market share and re-accelerating growth (21% YoY). $105B 2025 capex into AI training/inference. Bedrock is the enterprise AI platform of choice for regulated industries. Advertising ($56B, 18% growth) is a high-margin compounder. Near 52w high at -2.4%.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py AMZN after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Edison International
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Edison International — regulated California electric utility. 8% growth, 4.8% dividend, 10.9x fwd PE. Grid/electrification exposure BUT California wildfire liability is a major overhang. -6.7% from ATH (near high).
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py EIX after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Eaton Corporation plc
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Makes electrical switchgear, power distribution, and circuit breakers — the physical infrastructure for datacenter power delivery. Switchgear backlog sold out through 2026. 25.8x forward PE, 16.8% growth, $2.65B FCF. -6.7% from ATH — near peak.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py ETN after.

upcoming_earnings.name: LPL Financial Holdings Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: LPL Financial — largest independent broker-dealer platform. 35% revenue growth (!), 10x fwd PE, -29% from ATH. Fast-growing, cheap, advisor-network scale moat.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py LPLA after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Reddit, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: World's largest forum network. Revenue grew 69% YoY with 91.4% gross margin and 27.6% op margin. $0.56B FCF. 17.4x forward PE — cheapest in this batch relative to growth (PEG <0.3). AI data licensing (Google $60M/yr, OpenAI deal) is a new high-margin revenue layer. -45.5% from $282 ATH at $154 makes the entry compelling. International expansion (historically English-only) is untapped.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py RDDT after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: #2 AI GPU company. MI300X deployed at Microsoft Azure, Meta, and Oracle for inference workloads. EPYC CPUs now hold 33% of x86 data center market (up from 5% in 2019). 37.8% revenue growth, $7.7B AI GPU revenue guided for 2025. Key risk: CUDA software moat is 15 years deep — AMD wins on price/performance but requires significant porting effort, limiting ceiling.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py AMD after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Limbach Holdings, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Limbach — mechanical/HVAC systems contractor increasingly serving data centers. 4% growth, thin 1% op margin reported, 16x fwd PE, -47% from ATH. Small-cap data-center infra pick-and-shovel.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py LMB after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Eli Lilly and Company
upcoming_earnings.thesis: GLP-1 drug leader (Mounjaro, Zepbound). 55% revenue growth, 82.8% gross margin. Exceptional business — no theme fit for this portfolio.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py LLY after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Zimmer Biomet — orthopedic implants (hips, knees). 20% op margin, 9% growth, 9.7x fwd PE, -19% from ATH. Cheap medtech riding aging demographics.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py ZBH after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Constellation Energy Corporation
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Largest US nuclear operator (21 reactors). Signed 20-year PPA with Microsoft to restart Three Mile Island for AI datacenter power — the blueprint every hyperscaler is now copying. 64% revenue growth, 21.2x forward PE, -30% from ATH. Google/Oracle/Meta in active nuclear PPA negotiations. CEG is the only investable pure-play: you cannot build new baseload nuclear in under 10 years.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py CEG after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Makes 100G/400G/800G optical transceiver modules for AWS and Microsoft AI datacenter builds. Revenue grew 51.4% YoY as hyperscalers upgrade interconnects. 29.6% gross margin (improving), -8.6% op margin (still unprofitable). $14.4B market cap on $0.5B revenue = 28x P/S. -23% from $233 ATH. Path to profitability is the key question.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py AAOI after.

upcoming_earnings.name: MarketAxess Holdings Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: MarketAxess — electronic bond-trading platform. 44% op margin, 12% growth, network-effect moat. 12.8x fwd PE, -49.7% from ATH (!). High-quality exchange business deeply oversold.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py MKTX after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Vistra Corp.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Nuclear + gas power generator. 14.6x forward PE for 43% growth — cheapest AI power play in the market. Just closed Energy Harbor acquisition adding 4 nuclear plants. Illinois nuclear plants (Clinton, Quad Cities) are in direct crosshairs of AI datacenter power demand. Wholesale power prices in Texas and PJM rising structurally. -27% from $219 ATH.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py VST after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Makes EML laser chips and coherent optical components inside 400G/800G transceivers connecting AI GPU clusters. Only vertically integrated laser chip + transceiver company at scale. Revenue grew 90% YoY as AI datacenter optical upgrade cycle accelerates. 40.8% gross margin, 21.8% op margin. 49.8x forward PE. -16.9% from $1,085 ATH.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py LITE after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Coherent Corp.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Makes optical transceivers, lasers, and compound semiconductors for AI datacenters and telecom. Same 800G upgrade cycle thesis as LITE (Lumentum). 20.5% revenue growth, 37% gross margin, 46.6x forward PE. Negative FCF (-$0.20B). LITE is the better-valued optical play (90% growth vs 20.5% at similar PE). Add COHR only if LITE position is full.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py COHR after.
